title: form-toggle
description: One collected yes or no: a question, an optional line of detail, and the design system's switch. The standard form entry for anything a person agrees to or declines.

definition.name: form-toggle
definition.description: One collected yes or no: a question, an optional line of detail, and the design system's switch. The standard form entry for anything a person agrees to or declines.
definition.whenToUse: Collect a yes or no a person decides: a consent, a preference, a declaration that something applies to them. Not for a choice between several options, and not for a fact they type.

label.preview: Send me alerts about new deals

description.preview: Occasional email, and never more than once a week.

brief.description: The question, written as the statement the person is agreeing to or declining: 'Send me alerts about new deals'. Never phrase it so that OFF is the agreeable answer, and never ask for a consent the source does not require.
One line the source gives about what agreeing means in practice, such as how often, or what it is used for. Empty when the question says it all.
